title: Growing-rate scalar recentering and BRST boundary

recentering_boundary.necessary_scale: uniform semiboundedness requires 6gC_N^2-a_N>=c g sigma_N sqrt(log N/log log N)+O(1) after decreasing c
recentering_boundary.quantitative_failure: every window at most (c-epsilon)g sigma_N sqrt(log N/log log N) has bottoms tending to -infinity

mosco_transfer.weak_compactness: normalized growing-degree trials have weakly convergent subsequences in the fixed Gaussian Hilbert space
mosco_transfer.weak_limit: the weak limit may be zero; Mosco weak liminf still applies
mosco_transfer.failure: trial form values tend to -infinity, contradicting every finite semibounded Mosco weak-liminf candidate
mosco_transfer.brst: tensor with K1471's normalized degree-zero harmonic BRST vacuum to transfer the same obstruction to full forms and harmonic compression
